title: MNS Suporte Implementation Plan
html:
Product scope · Human actions · Validation

MNS Suporte was initialized from Orion on 2026-11-25. The manifest records its foundation ancestry.

Tracking

The V1 denominator is the number of rows in V1 work. Count a row as complete only after its acceptance criteria pass with recorded evidence. Report completed, in-progress, pending, and blocked counts on each handoff. Project decisions stay in the product scope or relevant ADR. Access that requires a human stays in the human-action checklist. Preserve task IDs and record scope changes here.

V1 work

Task Deliverable and acceptance Status Evidence or dependency
PJ-01 Establish a private GitHub repository. Verify the initial default branch, security settings and enforced CI gate. blocked Private repository and vulnerability alerts verified. Initial CI passed. Required branch protection depends on PH-11.
PJ-02 Record actors, scope, data ownership, first-release acceptance and the future AI boundary. completed Approved scope and acceptance.
PJ-06 Implement Meta callback verification and signed webhook ingestion. Verify the challenge, exact-byte HMAC, incoming identity fields and recipient scope with synthetic requests. completed Webhook tests passed. The API guide documents configuration.
PJ-07 Persist incoming messages before acknowledgement and deduplicate replays, including concurrent delivery, using the restricted database role. completed Webhook integration tests verified concurrent replays, PostgreSQL grants and failure acknowledgement.
PJ-08 Implement the Meta outbound adapter and durable sends. Test text and interactive replies, safe retries and delivery status handling. pending Depends on PJ-06 and PJ-07.
PJ-09 Implement the GLPI adapter and exact directory lookup. Test scoped credentials, timeouts, session renewal and explicit outcomes for mutations. pending Use synthetic GLPI fixtures locally. Test against company test access under PH-08.
PJ-10 Verify and persist employee identity with short-lived, rate-limited email challenges. Test invalid, replayed and expired codes, and access isolation between employees. pending Depends on PJ-08 and PJ-09. Mail relay access under PH-09.
PJ-11 Implement the menu, guided intake, resumable drafts, confirmation, editing, cancel and the direct path to IT. Test ordinary navigation and restart recovery. pending Depends on PJ-07, PJ-08 and PJ-10.
PJ-12 Provide approved static troubleshooting with a direct path to open a ticket. Record whether it helped. pending Depends on PJ-11.
PJ-13 Create GLPI tickets with attachments and confirmed summaries. Test duplicates, ambiguous creation outcomes and recoverable attachment failures. pending Depends on PJ-09 and PJ-11.
PJ-14 List the employee's open GLPI tickets and show authorized ticket details. Test ownership before disclosure and preserve existing ticket access through verified identity. pending Depends on PJ-09 and PJ-10.
PJ-15 Notify on closure, capture permission to receive updates and use the approved utility template when required. Verify retries and delivery tracking. pending Depends on PJ-08, PJ-13 and PJ-14. Live template under PH-07.
PJ-16 Package and document operation with a container, production configuration, restricted database access, retention, backup and restore, sanitized diagnostics, alerts and recovery procedures. Verify local deployment and rollback rehearsal. pending Starts after stable local flows. Company ingress and deployment access under PH-10.
PJ-19 Triage GitHub dependency alerts and upgrade affected dependencies or document verified non-applicability. Revalidate the lockfile and runtime boundaries before the pilot. pending GitHub reported eight alerts on the inherited baseline on 2026-11-25, four high and four moderate. Dependabot alerts.
PJ-17 Run the release acceptance suite against disposable infrastructure, then run a pilot with the test Meta number, company test GLPI and mail relay. Verify real end-to-end delivery and failure recovery. pending Depends on PJ-08 through PJ-16, PJ-19 and external test access.
PJ-18 Reconcile active legacy notifications and onboard verified employees. Deploy, verify smoke checks and supervise the switch to the corporate support number. pending Depends on PJ-17. Production access and the support number under PH-07, PH-08 and PH-10.

Plan changes and later work

  • PJ-03 was the generic first module. PJ-06 through PJ-15 replace it with independently verifiable product capabilities.
  • PJ-04 remains outside V1. The web shell already provides the local documentation portal and is available for a future operator interface.
  • PJ-05 is split across PJ-10 and PJ-16. Corporate email verification is the V1 identity mechanism, with deployment work verified independently.
  • Post-V1 candidates include supplementing tickets over WhatsApp, known incident notices, an editorial knowledge base, and optional AI guidance and summarization. The AI extension boundary governs that work. These items are outside the V1 progress denominator.
